title: In an abstract Setoid-flavored group, a fixed left factor can be cancelled
statement: For any AlgS.Group record G (an abstract carrier, a caller-supplied equivalence relation equiv with a congruence field for op, and the two-sided identity/inverse laws stated over equiv rather than Eq) and any a, b, c of G's carrier, if equiv (op a b) (op a c) then equiv b c -- the setoid twin of Alg.mul_left_cancel, proved by the identical six-step chain b = e.b = (a'.a).b = a'.(a.b) = a'.(a.c) = (a'.a).c = e.c = c (a' := inv a), with equivTrans/equivSymm/opCongr in place of Eq.trans/symm_of/congr_arg.

formal.statement: theorem AlgS.add_left_cancel : ((x0 : AlgS.Group) -> ((x1 : AlgS.Group.carrier x0) -> ((x2 : AlgS.Group.carrier x0) -> ((x3 : AlgS.Group.carrier x0) -> ((x4 : AlgS.Group.equiv x0 (AlgS.Group.op x0 x1 x2) (AlgS.Group.op x0 x1 x3)) -> AlgS.Group.equiv x0 x2 x3)))))

evidence.supports: AlgS.add_left_cancel admits through the trusted kernel gate, with an empty axiom footprint, and instantiated at AlgS.Group.ofAlg(Int.addGroup) closed over (a,b,c) is `def_eq` to Int.add_left_cancel's own declared type -- the same carrier theorem Alg.mul_left_cancel already retired to (ADR-1587), now reached from the setoid spine too. Also instantiated (well-typedness only, no named carrier theorem to compare against) at CReal's and Complex's additive Group, built inline from their commRingS Ring fields.
evidence.checker_command: out=$(RUST_MIN_STACK=1073741824 cargo test -p axeyum-lean-kernel --lib --release -- add_left_cancel_instantiated_at_int_through_ofalg_matches_int_add_left_cancel_type generic_add_left_cancel_instantiated_at_creal_type_checks generic_add_left_cancel_instantiated_at_complex_type_checks --test-threads=1 2>&1) && test "$(printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -cE 'test result: ok\. 3 passed; 0 failed')" -ge 1
evidence.notes: The pinned pattern requires the exact count ('3 passed; 0 failed') across all three instantiation tests. The Int test is a genuine def_eq comparison against Int.add_left_cancel's own type, not merely a type-check.

provenance.established_by: axeyum-lean-kernel nat_prelude::structures_setoid (declare_add_left_cancel), lane structures-unify, ADR-1590 -- the setoid twin of Alg.mul_left_cancel (ADR-1587), ported step for step, instantiated at three carriers.
provenance.source: crates/axeyum-lean-kernel/src/nat_prelude/structures_setoid.rs (declare_add_left_cancel, declared as AlgS.add_left_cancel; ring_s_additive_group_value, the CReal/Complex additive-Group term-builder); crates/axeyum-lean-kernel/src/creal/algebra_instance.rs and crates/axeyum-lean-kernel/src/complex/algebra_instance.rs (the CReal/Complex instantiation tests).

notes: The Setoid-flavored twin of F:alg-mul-left-cancel (ADR-1587). CReal and Complex have no named AlgS.Group value of their own; the instantiation goes through a new un-named, #[cfg(test)]-gated term-builder (ring_s_additive_group_value) rather than a formal Ring.toCommGroupS projection, which is out of ADR-1590's scope.
